function.name: calculate_tip
function.description: Calculate the total tip amount for a given total bill and tip percentage. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

bill_total.description: The total bill amount. This is a float type value.

tip_percentage.description: The tip percentage. This is a float type value.

split.description: Number of people the tip is split between. Default is 1.

• Popular dishes: Toro (fatty tuna), Uni (sea urchin), and the signature “Gen Roll.” | | **Sushi Park** | 1220 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015 | • Trendy, modern setting with a sushi bar that’s open 24/7.
• Renowned for creative rolls like the “Sushi Park Roll” and “Miso Black Cod.”
• Great for both casual diners and special occasions. | | **Sushi Ota** | 1200 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90015 | • A hidden gem known for its omakase experience.
• Chef Ota offers a meticulous tasting menu featuring seasonal fish.
• Ideal for sushi aficionados looking for an intimate, high-end experience. | ### Why These Stand Out - **Freshness & Quality:** All three restaurants source premium, often locally caught fish, ensuring top-tier freshness. - **Variety:** From traditional nigiri to inventive rolls, they cater to both purists and adventurous eaters. - **Atmosphere:** Whether you’re after a relaxed lunch or a sophisticated dinner, each place offers a distinct ambiance. **Recommendation:** If you’re looking for a classic, reliable sushi experience, **Sushi Gen** is a safe bet.
